profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Web Developer | React.js | Node.js | AWS - Netflix Contractor
profile.summary:
I'm Grant Smith, a passionate Senior Full Stack Developer with over 6 years of experience. Throughout my career, I've developed expertise in languages and technologies like JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, React.js, and AWS services, significantly enhancing user experiences and system performance in organizations such as PennyMac. My role often involves pioneering efficient solutions, such as introducing infrastructure as code, which dramatically improves operational efficiency.

Looking ahead, I aim to continue leveraging my technical and soft skills to drive impactful changes in the tech industry. My journey is one of continuous learning and contributing to meaningful projects that resonate with my passion for technology and innovation.

For collaborations or inquiries, feel free to reach out at grantsmith1256@gmail.com or connect with me on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Front-End Design · TypeScript · Next.js · Apollo GraphQL · Spinnaker · Technical Design · JavaScript · Java · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Writing and reviewing code and tests
• Reading requirements documentation from Product and translating into implementation tickets, and leading the team through execution
• Defining, reviewing, and documenting software and system designs in a high throughput, low latency microservices environment
• Enhancing systems' observability with proper metrics, monitors and alerts
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Next.js · GraphQL · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Worked closely with Product, UI/UX Designers, other fronted developers and backend developers to build customer-facing features in the Coinbase retail application (web and mobile).
• Developed our promotional Coinbase One sign-up flow for our Samsung partnership, integrated fee calculations to the server, and displayed targeted benefits to users.
• Created special promotions and discounts for Coinbase One users and non Coinbase One users.
• Refactored our frontend to be server side driven to allow us to bypass React Native’s 2 week deployment cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: GraphQL · React.js · React Native · TypeScript · GraphQL Relay · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Engaged in end-to-end development processes, from in-depth conceptual discussions to successful deployment, consistently contributing to the delivery of high-quality products in a production environment.
- Conducted bi-weekly presentations to both management and valued clients, showcasing completed components and ensuring alignment with project objectives and client expectations.
- Collaborated intensively with fellow engineers to efficiently tackle challenging assignments and achieve remarkable outcomes.
- Led system design and managed the epic for implementing a bulk upload process for parkers to users' parking facilities.
- Daily reviewed other developers Pull Requests (PRs).
- Created React.js, Next.js and TypeScript web pages utilizing Material UI components and Tailwind CSS.
- Built an External RESTful API, Public GraphQL API and Private GraphQL API using Node.js, Apollo GraphQL, Koa.js, Middy middleware, JWT tokens and TypeScript.
- Extended our caching solution with OpenSearch, significantly reducing wait times for users accessing critical data.
- Implemented end-to-end CSV exporting of important information for clients.
- Implemented Middleware using middy to establish consistency in logging, cache updates via SQS messaging, and GraphQL error handling.
- Utilized AWS SQS Messages to facilitate seamless event flows and manage extensive data volumes.
- Developed MySQL views to present net and gross prices along with applicable taxes.
- Leveraged the Serverless Framework to expand our AWS serverless infrastructure, implementing Lambdas, Event Bridges, SQS Queues, SQS Lambda Handlers, and AWS CloudWatch Log Groups for user audit logging.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · GraphQL · JavaScript · Node.js · REST API · React.js · SQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Worked in a small team to develop a comprehensive application from the ground up, focusing on application security, permissions-based architecture, and enhancing our serverless capabilities alongside DynamoDB and frontend state management.
- Collaborated with other developers and the tech lead to build a Next.js and Node.js application from scratch.
- Developed a collaborative Closing Disclosure application that reduced loan approval finalization time from 5 hours to just 15 minutes, achieving a 2000% increase in efficiency.
- Built an External RESTful API, Public GraphQL API and Private GraphQL API.
- Consistently maintained 90% code coverage using Jest and React Testing Library.
- Daily reviewed other developers Pull Requests (PRs).
- Implemented the design of over 100+ screens by utilizing our internal UI library, SCSS and Figma for screen references.
- Created a scalable, robust, permission-driven RESTful API using Node.js, Koa.js, Auth0 for authentication, and JWT middleware for token security while architecting and scaling our AWS DynamoDB database.
- Employed AWS SAM to expand our serverless architecture and partnered with DevSecOps to optimize our deployment processes via CI/CD pipelines for rapid releases.
- Played a key role in evaluating and assessing candidates for senior positions, ensuring alignment with the company's technical requirements and culture.
- Worked with other developers to design end-to-end solutions in a production environment.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Culver City, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Helped build multiple pages of Apple’s existing Vue.js internal Executive video streaming platform, to showcase shows and movies metrics.
Enhanced Node.js functions to gather information for the metric pages using knex and oracle.
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle SQL Developer · Oracle Database · TypeScript · Node.js · Vuex · Vue.js
